description.summary: You animate a bone with dark energy, giving it the power to float near your body and interpose itself against physical attacks
description.value: You animate a bone with dark energy, giving it the power to float near your body and interpose itself against physical attacks. This gives you damage reduction 5/-. Once the bone has prevented a total of 5 points of damage per caster level (maximum 50 points), it is destroyed and the spell is discharged.
